steps.title: Choose narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.detail: Map the agent's features to the narrowest scopes and note which are non-sensitive, sensitive or restricted.

steps.title: Prototype with Composio managed Gmail
steps.detail: Use Composio's managed Gmail app to test the agent before registering your own app.
steps.done_when: A test account connects and the agent runs

steps.title: Create Cloud project and consent screen
steps.detail: Configure branding, audience and data access in the Google Auth platform, and add all scopes.
steps.done_when: Consent screen configured with all scopes declared

steps.title: Verify domains and publish branding
steps.detail: Verify authorized domains, click Verify Branding, then Publish branding. Passing results are valid for 7 days.

steps.title: Draft justifications and demo script
steps.detail: Write scope justifications and a demo script showing the English OAuth flow, consent screen app name and each scope's feature.
steps.done_when: Justifications and script ready to use

steps.title: Record demo and submit verification
steps.detail: Record the demo video and submit data access verification in the Verification Center.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Check the Verification Center manually; reports say rejection emails may not arrive. Do not change branding while verification is in progress.

steps.title: Complete security assessment if required
steps.detail: Needed if restricted scope data is stored on or sent through servers. Reported timelines are long and costly.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config with own app
steps.detail: Create the OAuth client, then create the Composio auth config with your client ID and secret via Composio's API. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Auth config created and a test account connects

steps.title: Set up redirect proxy on your domain
steps.detail: Register a redirect URI on your own domain that returns a 302 redirect to Composio's callback.
steps.done_when: Test OAuth flow completes through your domain

traps.title: Apps in testing status still show a tester warning
traps.detail: Apps in testing status still show a tester warning screen, have a user cap in effect, and have a limited refresh token lifetime.

traps.title: Unverified apps are capped at 100 users
traps.detail: Unverified apps requesting sensitive or restricted scopes show warnings and are capped at 100 total users. Testing-status apps are also capped at 100 test users and refresh tokens last 7 days.

traps.title: Callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Google requires redirect-URI domains to be authorized and verified, and you cannot verify Composio's callback domain. Route the callback through your own domain.

traps.title: Review is slow and may be silent
traps.detail: Developers report about ten rejections over two months and no emails from Google. Check the Verification Center manually.

traps.title: Branding changes are locked during verification
traps.detail: Branding cannot be modified while verification is in progress; cancel first. Changed branding must be re-verified and published.

traps.title: Customer admins can block your app
traps.detail: Google verification does not override a Workspace admin's settings. Admins can mark an app Trusted, Limited or Blocked.

blockers.what_it_means: The app requests sensitive or restricted scopes without completed verification.

blockers.agent_can_help: Compare declared scopes with justification text and the demo script.
